verdict: No confirmed static blocker in the frozen two-path correction. The patch uses the original checker's literal-call facility for the two sensitive values, preserves actual path/operand/propagation checks, and adds source mutations invoking the original verifier. None of those tests or the original checker was executed by this review.

original_evidence.observed: 211 tests, 199 '... ok' lines, 12 errors. Eleven RootAdmin test methods fail in setUp's original global protected-file baseline at select_original_startup_entry; the other readback-marker error is a separate patch.

independent_replay.new_path_absent: The exact new QA path returned GitHub NOT_FOUND at the fixed 0081 ref; the add_file has before=null and expected_absent=true.

exact_checker_contract.source: scripts/verify_hepta_callers.py at 7a6709691c372504ca11b5d2a74e14ba819fca8f was fetched at the exact source ref and read.
exact_checker_contract.raw_required: _verify_protected_files checks required markers against raw text, then masks comments/literals/test-only items for code guards.
exact_checker_contract.function_scope: _verify_function_order requires a unique exact fn NAME(, slices its actual body, masks nested functions, and locates declared literal_calls only where the original source span equals the authoritative masked code span.
exact_checker_contract.literals: Both Some("late-writer") and required_path("CODEX_HOME") match the original exact single-literal-call grammar. A matching comment does not match the call's code-bearing masked span.
exact_checker_contract.unchanged_failure: The original VerificationFailure branches and cursor-based required-order algorithm are unchanged; no alternate verifier is supplied.

gate_by_gate.preserved: Original selection loop, ENTRY_FLAG comparison, duplicate selected.is_some rejection, actual != prefix, exact Some("late-writer"), wrong-value rejection, selected assignment, Existing return and argument drain/LateWriter return.
gate_by_gate.representation: Split the original code-plus-string condition into the same exact code prefix and declared literal_call. The two return Err( markers retain their original relative order.
gate_by_gate.rejection_reason: Changing the literal or supplying the old literal only in a comment leaves zero valid actual literal matches; reversing != removes the required comparison prefix.

gate_by_gate.preserved: Exact environment key, original required_path call, ? propagation/comma before current_dir, and the final actual identity read.
gate_by_gate.representation: Declare required_path("CODEX_HOME") as literal_call, followed by ?, and the existing std::env::current_dir()? marker.
gate_by_gate.rejection_reason: A wrong key/comment spoof fails exact literal matching. Removing its ? makes a later ?, occur only after the current_dir marker begins, so the next required guard cannot be matched after that cursor.

gate_by_gate.gate: canonical fleet and three exact paths
gate_by_gate.preserved: Original actual/expected operand prefixes, original )?; propagation, next real guard in the same actual function, lifecycle Starting/generation and workspace checks.
gate_by_gate.representation: Keep four complete original diagnostic-label calls as raw required text; use their code-bearing operand prefixes and suffix/next-guard order for actual-code checks.
gate_by_gate.diagnostic_label_limit: Raw required text does NOT prove the actual label's literal span. Changing a diagnostic label and retaining the old call text in a comment is not claimed to be rejected. This is deliberately distinct from sensitive entry/key literal checks.
gate_by_gate.original_helper_fact: In config.rs, require_canonical uses path.canonicalize and canonical != path; require_exact_path invokes original require_canonical and compares actual != expected. label is used only for format! error diagnostics.

propagation_cross_call_analysis.reason: If the canonical call loses ?, the next )?; is at the snapshot call's end; its required next-guard start is already before the cursor, so it cannot substitute.
Borrowing the run-root call's suffix moves the cursor past the required run-root prefix and fails order.
Borrowing the Codex-home suffix moves the cursor past its required prefix and fails order.
Borrowing canonicalize's suffix moves the cursor past that required next guard and fails order.

mutation_review.setup: Each test setUp copies the two actual fixed source files into a TemporaryDirectory, requires exactly those two protected rows in their original order, and calls the original _verify_protected_files for the unmodified baseline.
mutation_review.mutation_calls: Every case calls rejects, asserts exactly one original occurrence, writes that exact mutation to the copied source, and asserts the specified original MODULE.VerificationFailure message through the original _verify_protected_files. finally restores the original bytes, including between subtests.
mutation_review.no_mirror_verifier: The new QA imports the repository's original checker; it defines no replacement checker or authority implementation.
mutation_review.literal_cases: Four literal value/comment cases exercise original unique-actual-literal rejection; != reversal and duplicate rejection deletion exercise code order.
mutation_review.path_cases: Four comment-removal, four actual-operand, three expected-operand and four propagation mutations retain the original full call in a comment. Thus raw required text remains satisfied while actual-code guard failure is required.
mutation_review.counted_separately: CODEX_HOME propagation removal is the seventh non-path mutation; total 7 + 4 + 4 + 3 + 4 = 22.
mutation_review.static_vs_execution: The expected rejection branch for each case was reviewed against the original implementation and fixed source. No result here claims that Python actually executed these 22 mutations.

limits.broader_source_proof: This review is limited to the concrete frozen markers/mutations. It does not claim a complete semantic proof against arbitrary Rust rewrites or prove diagnostic label spans.
limits.execution_required: Root must still run the original B4 and complete caller/native gates on the new fixed integrated source; old results are not inherited.
